title: Create grouped splits and comparable baseline manifests
summary: Define repeatable episode-level data partitions and arm manifests that isolate the semantic contribution. Prevent duplicates, source-derived summaries and iterative question rewrites from leaking across tuning and final evaluation, and make evidence differences visible instead of attributing them to a model.
in_scope: Deterministic grouped partitions and arm manifests
Frozen baseline/candidate inputs and declared ablations
out_of_scope: Selecting the best threshold on the final test split
Comparisons with unmatched evidence hidden behind aggregate metrics
implementation: Group all related observations, occurrences and derived summaries by episode/provenance before partitioning; retain the assignment seed and group keys.
Create distinct tuning, qualification and final evaluation partitions with a manifest that records when a reused held-out set became tuning data.
Define A as the deterministic policy and B as that same policy plus declared semantic families, using identical event streams and fixed packet profiles.
Reject incomparable arm manifests unless the changed retrieval or preparation is declared as a separate experiment with its own scope.
Emit leakage diagnostics, per-partition label/support counts and a reproducible paired case mapping.

acceptance.criterion: No source lineage or occurrence group appears in more than one partition.
acceptance.verification: Run a deliberate paraphrase/copy leakage fixture and assert a blocking split diagnostic.

acceptance.criterion: A and B resolve to exactly the same eligible cases and packet snapshots in the principal comparison.
acceptance.verification: Compare manifest hashes and reject a hidden candidate-only attachment.

acceptance.criterion: Changing a tuning seed is reproducible and cannot silently replace a frozen final partition.
acceptance.verification: Generate twice with the same seed and require an explicit new manifest revision for a changed partition.

tests: A late summary of an earlier episode stays in that group.
A retrieval-enhanced arm is labeled separately.
Repeated optimization against qualification data is recorded as tuning exposure.
risks: Provider improvements can be confused with better evidence preparation.

reuse.application: Follow explicit locked evaluation inputs while adding episode-level partitioning and a protected final split.
